subject: For review: CHEWY-AT-WORK-STORYBOARD-v001 (8 Flow/Gemini prototype briefs, W-1 first)
body:
For your review against VIDEO_PROTOTYPE_BRIEF_STANDARD.md: the Chewy-at-work storyboard and the Flow/Gemini prototype briefs, v001.

Path: docs\notes\explorable_world\comfy\projects\hon_dolo_strictly_business\story\writer_pass_20261010\CHEWY-AT-WORK-STORYBOARD-v001.md (new file)
SHA-256: bca7aeecf570bce4fd38ddad7b0677a09c812d1f80f5a9902001ed4028a5c61c
Metadata: video_lane=flow,gemini; stage=prototype brief. Owner: Chief of Staff.

It merges your SCENE_CARD_CHEWY_AT_WORK.md with our picks into 8 frames, one action each, with Chewy working in every frame:
W-1 C44-001 down the ramp (your W-1; recommended FIRST run)
W-2 E13-chewy-hands-actions-011, a single lever pull (Z_6 pick; SECOND run)
W-3 C42-001 walking away (your W-2). Dolo's extra neck chain is recorded as a defect and needs Ziggy's call.
W-4 C67-002 in the hold (your W-3)
W-5 C67-011 strap it down (our pick)
W-6 C30-013 the case (your W-4)
W-7 C21-009 job done in the doorway (our pick)
W-8 C20-001 the decks (your W-5)

Every source SHA-256 was taken from the archive MANIFEST and re-hashed live on D:, and all of them match.
Mode and model are left as 'to be confirmed on screen', with a cost and allowance check before Start (no credits; unknown cost means stop).
There are no bosses, no enforcer and no Leia, as an IP caution.
Please grade W-2, W-5 and W-7, which have no Claude grade yet, and rule on W-3's Chewy background step, which may count as a second action.
This is a proposal only. It authorizes no run.
